functions.evidence: Reads the non-speculative Apple timebase (S3_4_C15_C10_6, KERNEL_CNTVCTSS_EL0 of machine_routines.c) and adds the CPU's base timebase (current thread -> CpuDatap -> +88), retrying when the CPU changed. corecrypto calls it first in a FIPS timing function after its POST.
The same timebase read as mach_absolute_time, stored to *x0 and returning nothing: clock_get_uptime(uint64_t *).

prng_funcs.refresh(prng_ctx) (an authenticated call through a global, prng_ctx from another), then while numbytes: prng_funcs.generate(prng_ctx, cpu_number() (TPIDR_EL1 +0x1b0), MIN(numbytes, 0x100), buffer): read_random of osfmk/prng/prng_random.c with read_random_generate inlined. corecrypto and AppleImage4 call it for entropy. (Paired with SHA512_Init before: a string scan that ran past this function's end; the original SHA512_Init is 0xfffffe000b42b644, which the matcher pairs. AppleImage4's nonce buffer then got a SHA-512 context, written over its interface pointer.)

Returns -1 when a global pointer is already set, else stores x0 there (and sets a flag): register_crypto_functions(funcs) of libkern/crypto/register_crypto.c. corecrypto calls it with its function table (in its __DATA_CONST) right after the POST.
TPIDR_EL1 (the current thread), a 16-bit load from its machine area: cpu_number() of osfmk/arm/cpu_common.c, current_thread()->machine.cpu_number.
A one-branch thunk to sched_cpu_init_completed (paired by reference order); the native ml_cpu_init_completed is the same thunk.
A one-branch thunk to hw_lock_unlock (paired), right after the paired IOSimpleLockLock (0xfffffe000aec08f4) of IOLocks.cpp: the RELEASE IOSimpleLockUnlock, lck_spin_unlock inlined to its tail call.

data.evidence: A struct vnodeop_desc whose vdesc_name is "vnop_getnamedstream"; vnode_getnamedstream reads it (a_desc and vdesc_offset). APFS's vnode operation table names it: left unpaired, the entry pointed into native zone data and vfs_fsadd faulted on it ("Ignoring reference ... to disabled operation .", then a data abort).
The struct vnodeop_desc named "vnop_makenamedstream", next to vnop_getnamedstream's; in APFS's vnode operation table.
The struct vnodeop_desc named "vnop_removenamedstream", next to vnop_makenamedstream's; in APFS's vnode operation table.

The arg1 of the sandbox's sysctl OID "audio_active" ("Audio active", format I): a 32-bit kernel global that the EXC_RESOURCE path reads as `disable_exc_resource_during_audio && audio_active && task->task_jetsam_realtime_audio` (osfmk/kern/task.c, exported in Private.exports).
